$comment: Approved secrets that may be reachable by a job running on a plain (non-full-pipeline) pull request. Seeded 2026-09-26 from the actual PR-reachable surface (node scripts/check-pr-secret-exposure.mjs --report). Deploy/infra creds (CLOUDFLARE_*, ADMIN_KEY, CF_ACCESS_*, X_OCR_INTERNAL, FORMS_*, SMOKE_RPT_*) are deliberately ABSENT — they are gated behind full-pipeline/deploy and must never appear here. Any addition is a security decision and is CODEOWNERS-locked. See docs/security/PR_SECRET_EXPOSURE_GUARD.md and docs/adr/ADR-020-copilot-ci-human-approval-gate.md.

approved.OCR_PROPAGATE_TOKEN: WRITE-CAPABLE org token (the same secret OCR-docs propagate-standards.yml uses to push branches and open PRs in every spoke) — NOT read-scoped (corrected 2026-09-29, CCR OSE-1393 F12). Used on PRs to fetch the pinned hub (@ocr/ui REQUIRED to build the Worker, ADR-008; @ocr/flags) + the OCR-docs brain in S0/T0 and other PR gates; always step-scoped and passed as a transient http.extraheader. Broadest PR footprint; split into a read-only checkout token + a write identity is tracked in OSE-1045 / OW-116.
approved.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: claude-review.yml runs Claude PR review on every PR; needs model access. Fallback only: passed to the action when CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN is unset.
approved.CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN: claude-review.yml: Claude subscription token, the preferred auth for Claude PR review (usage counts against the owner's subscription, not API billing). Same reach as ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: model access only, no repo or infra scope. Skipped when repo variable PR_REVIEWER=copilot.
approved.LINEAR_API_KEY: brain-contract-check.yml + premature-close-detector.yml open/inspect Linear tickets on PRs.
approved.GITHUB_TOKEN: Auto-provisioned, permission-restricted at the workflow level (default_workflow_permissions: read). Not a custom exfiltratable secret; surfaced for visibility.
approved.BRANCH_PROTECTION_READ_TOKEN: gate-execution-reconciler (if: always()) reads branch-protection required-check state on every PR to reconcile gate execution. Read-scoped.
